definition_zh_tw: 兩眼看到不同影像時，知覺在兩個影像之間交替主導，刺激本身保持不變，常用於分離視網膜輸入與意識知覺。
definition_en: When the two eyes see different images, perception alternates between them while the stimulus stays constant. Used to separate retinal input from conscious perception.
source: research/03_background_review.md §1 Binocular rivalry and flash suppression basics

definition_zh_tw: 先將前導刺激呈現給一眼，再向另一眼閃現新影像，後者通常主導知覺，前者因而被抑制。
definition_en: A primer image is shown to one eye, then a new image is flashed to the other eye, which usually dominates perception.

definition_zh_tw: 約數十毫秒的短時段，群體表徵在有意識與受抑制內容間切換；Hesse等人2026預印本估計約每秒15次。
definition_en: Short window of tens of milliseconds in which population activity represents either the conscious or the suppressed stimulus. Hesse et al. 2026 estimate about 15 per second.

definition_zh_tw: 微時段中，神經群體表徵被知覺刺激的狀態。Hesse等人（2026）以神經資料推斷此標籤，並以人類按鍵驗證。
definition_en: Micro-epoch state in which the population represents the perceived stimulus. The label is inferred from neural data in monkeys and validated by human button press.

definition_zh_tw: 微時段中，神經群體表徵未被知覺刺激的狀態，與有意識狀態交替出現；猴子未作回報，標籤由神經資料推斷。
definition_en: Micro-epoch state in which the population represents the stimulus not perceived. It alternates with the conscious state. Monkeys gave no report, so labels are inferred.

definition_zh_tw: 足以共同支持某一特定意識經驗的最小神經機制集合，常以有意識與無意識條件對照來實證研究。
definition_en: Minimal neural mechanisms jointly sufficient for a specific conscious experience. Studied empirically by contrasting conscious and unconscious conditions.
source: research/03_background_review.md §2 The neural correlates of consciousness (NCC)

definition_zh_tw: 不要求受試者回報知覺，改以眼動或神經資料推斷知覺，以排除回報、決策與運動活動的干擾。
definition_en: Design that infers perception without asking subjects to report it, avoiding contamination from report-related decision and motor activity.
source: research/03_background_review.md §3 No-report paradigms and the report confound

definition_zh_tw: 回報、決策或注意等與報告相關的活動，可能被誤認為意識本身的神經相關物。
definition_en: Risk that report-related decision, motor and attention activity is mistaken for the neural correlate of consciousness itself.

definition_zh_tw: 獼猴顳葉皮質中以fMRI定位、對臉的反應明顯強於物體的區域；區域內神經元多數對臉具選擇性。
definition_en: Macaque temporal cortex region, localized by fMRI, responding more to faces than objects. Most cells inside are face-selective.

definition_zh_tw: 下顳葉臉部斑塊之一，為Hesse等人2026年研究記錄神經元的區域之一。
definition_en: One of the IT face patches recorded in Hesse et al. 2026, localized by fMRI (faces versus objects). ML stands for middle lateral.

definition_zh_tw: 下顳葉臉部斑塊之一；據Freiwald與Tsao（2010），身分編碼從ML到AM趨向視角不變。
definition_en: IT face patch recorded in Hesse et al. 2026. Identity coding becomes more viewpoint-invariant from ML to AM (Freiwald and Tsao 2010).

definition_zh_tw: 顳葉腹側的高階視覺皮質，內含臉部斑塊；早期猴子雙眼競爭研究發現許多神經元追隨知覺。
definition_en: High-level ventral visual cortex containing face patches. Early monkey rivalry studies found many IT neurons followed the percept (Sheinberg and Logothetis 1997).

definition_zh_tw: 額葉前部的皮質；Hesse等人2026年在此記錄前額葉臉部斑塊，重建品質低於下顳葉皮質。
definition_en: Anterior frontal cortex. Hesse et al. 2026 recorded PFC face-related patches (PO, PVL), with lower reconstruction quality than in IT.

definition_zh_tw: 高密度矽基電極探針，可在單一探針上同時記錄大量神經元；本研究使用Neuropixels 1.0 NHP版本。
definition_en: High-density silicon electrode probe that records many neurons at once. The 2026 study used Neuropixels 1.0 NHP probes in two macaques.

definition_zh_tw: 以不可直接觀測的隱藏狀態與可觀測資料建模的機率模型；本研究以兩狀態泊松HMM估計兩種微時段狀態。
definition_en: Probabilistic model with hidden states that emit observations. The 2026 study fit a two-state Poisson HMM to binned spike counts.

definition_zh_tw: 隱馬可夫模型中找出最可能隱藏狀態序列的動態規劃演算法；本研究與HMM併用以指派狀態。
definition_en: Dynamic-programming algorithm that finds the most likely hidden state sequence in an HMM. The 2026 study used it alongside the HMM to assign states.

definition_zh_tw: 比較兩種假設下資料概似的對數比值；本研究以泊松LLR在10毫秒時間窗（bin）上計算。
definition_en: Log of the ratio of data likelihoods under two hypotheses. The 2026 study computed Poisson LLRs in 10 ms bins.

definition_zh_tw: 同一狀態持續的時間。Hesse等人2026：IT平均67毫秒、中位數約46毫秒；HMM中位數約59至64毫秒。
definition_en: Duration a population stays in one micro-epoch state before switching. Hesse et al. 2026 report IT mean 67 ms, median about 46 ms; HMM medians 59 to 64 ms.

definition_zh_tw: 由神經群體活動推定刺激或知覺內容的分析方法，通常以分類器訓練後評估正確率。
definition_en: Inferring which stimulus or percept is represented from neural activity, usually by training a classifier and scoring accuracy against chance.

definition_zh_tw: 只用單次試驗的神經活動解碼。2026年研究中，10類分類正確率：有意識約40%、受抑制約34%（機率10%）。
definition_en: Decoding from one trial's neural activity rather than averaged trials. Full-window 10-class accuracy was about 40% conscious and 34% suppressed (chance 10%).

definition_zh_tw: 由神經群體活動估計刺激特徵（如臉空間座標）的過程，其品質以解釋變異量評估。
definition_en: Estimating stimulus features, such as face-space coordinates, from population activity. Quality is scored by explained variance.

definition_zh_tw: 重建能解釋的真實特徵變異比例。Hesse等人2026：IT部分特徵超過80%，PFC前導刺激條件下低於80%。
definition_en: Proportion of true feature variance that a reconstruction captures. Preprint: IT above 80% for some features in state 1; PFC priming EV under 80%.

definition_zh_tw: 同一組神經元在不同時段交替編碼不同內容，而非由不同神經元同時分別編碼（專案用語）。
definition_en: Same neurons carry different content in alternating time windows, rather than separate neurons coding each simultaneously. Project label; the preprint reports same neurons switching content.

term_zh_tw: 全域神經工作空間理論
definition_zh_tw: 意識源於資訊在前額與頂葉網路中被點燃並廣播，使內容可供報告與彈性使用。
definition_en: Consciousness arises when information ignites and is broadcast across a fronto-parietal network, becoming available for report and flexible use.

definition_zh_tw: 意識對應於物理系統的內在因果結構（整合資訊）；強調後側皮質「熱區」。
definition_en: Consciousness corresponds to a physical system's intrinsic cause-effect structure, measured as integrated information. Emphasizes a posterior cortical hot zone.

definition_zh_tw: 全域工作空間理論中，資訊突然持續廣播至全域網路的事件。Cogitate（2025）報告刺激結束時普遍缺乏點燃。
definition_en: In GNWT, the sudden, self-sustaining broadcast of a representation across a fronto-parietal network. Cogitate Consortium (2025) reported a general lack of ignition at stimulus offset.

definition_zh_tw: 由相互競爭理論的支持者共同設計、預先註冊的實驗，用以檢驗各理論的相異預測。
definition_en: Experiments co-designed by proponents of rival theories and preregistered to test conflicting predictions. Cogitate Consortium (2025) tested GNWT and IIT this way.

definition_zh_tw: 主張注意力以離散節律週期取樣，而非連續運作；如Landau與Fries（2012）報告兩位置合計約8赫茲交替取樣。
definition_en: View that attention samples the world in discrete rhythmic cycles rather than continuously. For example, two locations are sampled alternately at about 8 Hz total (Landau and Fries 2012).
source: research/03_background_review.md §6 Rhythmic and temporal sampling of perception and attention

definition_zh_tw: 約4至8赫茲的腦波頻段。2026預印本以θ相位工作記憶存取連結微時段時序，屬推測；其15赫茲頻率不屬θ頻段。
definition_en: Brain rhythm of about 4 to 8 Hz. The preprint links micro-epoch timing to theta-phase working-memory access as speculation; its roughly 15 Hz rate is outside theta.
source: research/03_background_review.md §6 How the 15 Hz micro-epoch finding relates; research/02_paper_card.md §6 Authors' limitations

definition_zh_tw: 約8至12赫茲的腦波頻段。2026預印本未討論α節律；約15赫茲的微時段頻率高於此頻段。
definition_en: Brain rhythm of about 8 to 12 Hz. The 2026 preprint does not discuss alpha; its roughly 15 Hz alternation sits above this band.
source: research/03_background_review.md §6 How the 15 Hz micro-epoch finding relates

definition_zh_tw: 尚未經同儕審查即公開於預印本伺服器（如bioRxiv）的研究報告；Hesse等人2026年研究即屬此類。
definition_en: Research report posted publicly before peer review, for example on bioRxiv. Hesse et al. 2026 is a bioRxiv preprint and is not peer reviewed.

definition_zh_tw: 投稿期刊前後，由同領域獨立專家評估論文品質與正確性的程序。
definition_en: Independent expert evaluation of a manuscript's quality and validity, usually before journal publication. The Hesse et al. 2026 preprint has not undergone it.
source: research/03_background_review.md 前言 (Intro); research/02_paper_card.md 狀態警示 (Status warnings)

definition_zh_tw: 以軸向座標描述臉部特徵的高維表徵空間；臉部神經元對這些軸作線性投影。
definition_en: High-dimensional space in which faces are coded along axes; face cells linearly project onto these axes (Chang and Tsao 2017).

definition_zh_tw: 受試者或猴子在某一時刻實際看到的影像，在雙眼競爭或閃光抑制中可能與物理刺激不同。
definition_en: The image actually perceived at a given moment, which may differ from the physical stimulus in rivalry or flash suppression.

definition_zh_tw: 閃光抑制中，先呈現給一眼的影像。本研究的前導刺激呈現1秒或2秒。
definition_en: Image shown to one eye before the flash in flash suppression. In the 2026 study the priming image lasted 1 or 2 seconds.

definition_zh_tw: 用同一資料先選出特徵、再在同一資料上檢驗，會使結果偏誤。Hesse等人以保留神經元處理此問題。
definition_en: Selecting features and testing them on the same data, which inflates results. The 2026 preprint addressed this initial circularity with held-out neurons.

definition_zh_tw: 未用於選取或建模的神經元子集，用以獨立檢驗解碼或重建結果。
definition_en: Subset of neurons withheld from selection or model fitting and used to independently test decoding or reconstruction results.

definition_zh_tw: 打亂或翻轉資料以建立虛無分布，再計算觀察統計量之p值的檢定法。
definition_en: Test that builds a null distribution by reshuffling or sign-flipping data. The 2026 preprint used sign-flip permutation tests with 100,000 permutations.

definition_zh_tw: 雙眼競爭的變體：先對一眼呈現前導刺激，再向另一眼閃現新影像，後者通常主導知覺。Hesse等人（2026）的範式，勿簡稱為經典雙眼競爭。
definition_en: A variant of binocular rivalry in which a priming image is shown to one eye and a new image is then flashed to the other eye, which usually dominates. The paradigm of Hesse et al. 2026; not classic free rivalry.

definition_zh_tw: 影像每秒更新的格數。Tsao澄清並未證明「意識有影格率」；約15次／秒是群體表徵內容的交替，不是意識的影格率。
definition_en: Number of image frames per second. Tsao clarified that it was not shown that consciousness has a frame rate; the roughly 15 per second is alternation of population-represented content.

definition_zh_tw: 以點標示每個神經元在各時間點放電的圖，橫軸時間、縱軸神經元；本研究範例圖含429個同時記錄的細胞。
definition_en: Plot marking each neuron's spikes over time (time on the x axis, neurons on the y axis). The example in the 2026 study shows 429 simultaneously recorded cells.
